title: Coherent reduction and strict tower realization data
statement: Fix a prime ell and a finite extension E of Q_ell [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension]. For every scheme W and morphism f:X→Y use the actual coherent coefficient systems [def-coef-ringed-sequence-site] and their derived evaluation calculus [lem-coef-derived-system-evaluation-calculus]. Construct their sequence-site pullback and direct-image adjunction from the canonical constant-section ring map [def-trf-integral-comparison-sequence-systems]. Construct the ordinary coherent reduction left adjoint to completed scalar restriction followed by the inverse limit. Fix its derived reduction model by its adjunction unit on flat K-flat complexes, and fix each finite evaluation by the actual quotient-extension unit. Fix direct evaluation by identity on sections, and inverse evaluation by the corresponding adjunction mate. Reorder restricted coherent complexes into completed-module towers. Fix the total-limit/Roos comparison on K-injective towers by the limit-projection augmentation and zero second cone coordinate [def-sf-strict-roos-functor]. Fix the pullback and tensor tower comparisons by their prescribed finite components, using the strict finite pullback tower [def-a1-integral-finite-pullback-tower]. In particular, for each coherent complex C, pullbackTensorLimitRoos identifies the actual total limit of Q(C) with Q of the strict Roos complex of its restricted tower. All existing existence/uniqueness obligations retain their full displayed normalizations, with no boundedness or termwise-flatness hypothesis added. Finite coefficient rings and their finite instances use [def-pur-finite-pullback-tensor-construction]. Construct the coherent reference pullback and tensor from reduction, sequence pullback/tensor and total limit. Fix the actual integral pullback and tensor models by their full strict Roos realizations. State K-flat preservation for coherent reduction and sequence inverse image, with no termwise-flatness assumption. Fix the ordinary coherent tensor/pullback comparison by its full finite components on flat K-flat representatives, and its derived comparison by the universal reduction counits and that cochain comparison. All these existing normalizations and their uniqueness clauses are retained verbatim.

proof.text: Use the existing core for the sequence ring map, adjunctions, exactness and identity/mate evaluation data, and for the unique ordinary finite evaluation and derived reduction models fixed there by their transpose equations (the actual quotient unit followed by the nth limit projection, and the right-derived limit unit after the ordinary unit); these equations fix the required units, not just isomorphism classes.

Apply the normalized total-limit/Roos model of the core to the exact scalar-restriction localization comparison. Their composite is pullbackTensorLimitRoos. Its K-injective formula is exactly the limit-projection lift with zero shifted coordinate, so both cone coordinates and the actual derived unit are retained.
